title: Botfather bot manifest
description: The manifest.json file specifies metadata for Botfather bots.

$schema.description: The JSON schema this file follows. Botfather itself ignores it.

manifest_version.description: The manifest format version. Currently always 1.

script.description: The path of the bot's script file, relative to the bot's folder. If the file doesn't exist, Botfather uses the first .js file it finds in the bot's folder (in alphabetical order).

config.description: The config options shown in the bot's Config tab. The Config tab is disabled unless there is at least one option with an id.

groups.description: Groups only organise how options are shown. Empty groups are not shown.

group.description: A box in the Config tab holding some config options.

name.description: The title of the group's box in the Config tab.

options.description: The config options shown in this group.

option.description: A config option. Its value is read in the script with Config.getValue(id).

id.description: Used to read the option's value with Config.getValue. Options without an id are skipped.

type.description: Sets which input the user sees.

label.description: The text shown next to the input.

default.description: The value used until the user changes it. It is saved as soon as the bot's Config tab is first shown, so changing it later won't change values that are already saved.

min.description: The smallest value allowed. Only works if max is set too.

max.description: The largest value allowed. Only works if min is set too.

choices.description: Maps the text shown in the dropdown to the value returned by Config.getValue. The choices are listed in alphabetical order of their text.

then.description: Shown as a checkbox. The value is true or false.
Shown as a spinbox for whole numbers. Without min and max the spinbox only allows values from 0 to 99.
Shown as a spinbox for decimal numbers. min and max are rounded to whole numbers. Without them the spinbox only allows values from 0 to 99.99.
Shown as a text field. The label is also used as the field's placeholder text. Password values are hidden while typing, but saved as plain text.
Shown as a dropdown menu. The value is the string of the choice the user selected.

default.description: One of the choice values. Otherwise no choice is selected until the user picks one.
